messages.subject: covariates on multi-session density
parts:
Hi All,

After searching around a bit, I couldn't find an answer to this question so I thought I would pose it to the group.   I'm working with a student that has a large multi-session dataset.  Is a way to specify density as function of covariates in a multi-session model?  In this case, the covariate is continuous and is measured at the session (or site) level.   Fitting the standard D~cov results in each session getting a separate density, but it does not appear to fit a linear relationship.  We would like to fit 

Thanks for any help you can lend.

Cheers,
Beth

parts:
Hi
Can you give us a bit more info - where does cov come from, are you using the sessioncov argument, etc. Are you setting newdata in predict? I assume you have the default log link for D. 
Murray

parts:
Hi Murray,

I found an earlier post where you said that each session needs a separate trap file (took a bit to get all the trap files to read in properly) and now the model fits like I expected it to!  
And I had forgot about the sessioncov argument, so that was an obvious error as well.   Thanks.

Cheers,
Beth
